BonusDashFeatures.Name: Bonus-action Dash features
BonusDashFeatures.Hint: Comma-separated names of features (or active effects) that let a character Dash as a bonus action. A character with one of them can dash twice per round: once with the action and once with the bonus action. Spells the character knows don't count, only their active effect.

AutoOpenPanel.Name: Open the panel when exploration starts
AutoOpenPanel.Hint: Opens the Exploration panel when the GM starts Exploration Mode on the scene you're viewing.
